Перейдите в каталог `~/pool-destroy`.

:::{#exr-lab-libvirt-storage-pools-pool-destroy}
#### Остановка pool без удаления данных

Выполните:

```bash
sudo -n virsh -c qemu:///system pool-destroy lab-pool
sudo -n virsh -c qemu:///system pool-info lab-pool > pool-info-after-destroy.txt
sudo -n virsh -c qemu:///system pool-start lab-pool
sudo -n virsh -c qemu:///system pool-info lab-pool > pool-info-after-restart.txt
sudo -n virsh -c qemu:///system vol-list lab-pool > vol-list-after-restart.txt
```
:::
